note: Measured stream kinematics at the coffee surface (M1 inversion of the validated milk column; SPEC27 rev 2 section 1). Allow-listed fields only. Cup frame F, SI. a_f is prior-dominated.

conventions.board: board frame: x, y horizontal, z DOWN (the spout tip has smaller z than the surface); V = board y about the disc centre, V < 0 pitcher side; col25 slope s = dx_board/dh (point at height h = foot + h (sx, sy, -z_hat))
conventions.cup_F: cup frame F = (x_b, -y_b, up) about the disc centre (real_program S_FLIP); u_F = S (u_board - V_cup)
conventions.solver: solver units: lengths / L (L = L_m / 0.49 m), time unscaled -> velocity / L

gate: F0 = use_kin and H_tip < 15 mm; E1 = central exit speed <= sqrt(2 g (H_head + 3 mm)), H_head the production weir head at the emission step nearest t - a_f; windows = accepted frames clustered at gaps > 0.5 s, >= 3 frames, [first, last]; gated = F0 and E1 and inside a window (SPEC27 1.1)

gp.model: zero-mean GP per residual r_q = q_meas - q_law: Matern-3/2 (s_f, l) + white s_n + per-point noise eta * stat sd68; hyperparameters by maximum marginal likelihood (eta in [0.3, 3], l in [0.04, 8] s) in spec/code2/resgp.py, frozen here
gp.pairing: MI-law arrival record Q-weighted over |t_arr - t| <= 0.02 s and Q > 1e-06 m^3/s

provenance.col25: col25 rev 2 Method-A foot + line slope (M1 inversion); landing feet stream_foot_col.json (validated A/B)
provenance.spec: mi27 SPEC27 rev 2 sections 1, 3.3; PREREG27_2 section 2
